scenario: Non-Idempotent sync.Once Poisoning on Transient Failure
rely: Initial sync.Once execution succeeds or failed initialization is not permanently memoized.
guarantee: Subsequent healthy callers obtain valid connection string when shouldFail is false.
interleaving_trigger: G1 calls Init(true) which consumes sync.Once and stores error; G2 calls Init(false) expecting recovery but receives cached error.
